title: CodonSequence
description:
The canonical internal sequence representation (BRIEF-2.2-a). Every module speaks this type; FASTA/GenBank exist only at the ingest boundary.

FRAME SAFETY IS STRUCTURAL, NOT VALIDATED. The coding region is stored as `cds`, whose regex admits only whole codons, and untranslated context is stored in separate `five_prime_flank`/`three_prime_flank` fields. There is therefore no representable state in which an edit shifts the reading frame: the only mutating operation the type exposes is `substitute(codon_index, codon)`, which replaces three characters at offset 3*i.

In memory the codons are a Vec<u8> of codon indices under the convention index = 16*b0 + 4*b1 + b2 with A=0, C=1, G=2, T=3. The JSON form is a plain string because planning artifacts, golden tests and bug reports must be human-readable and diffable.

INVARIANTS (checked by TST-CORE-001, enforced at construction):
  I1  len(cds) == 3 * codon_count
  I2  translate(cds, translation_table) == protein
  I3  protein is invariant under every operator in cf-search and cf-constraints
  I4  every locked span lies within [0, codon_count)
  I5  digest == sha256 of the RFC 8785 canonical JSON of this document with `digest` removed

alphabet.description: Fixed. RNA input is transcoded at ingest so that no downstream module needs an alphabet branch.

translation_table.description: NCBI genetic code id. 11 = bacterial/plastid, 1 = standard, 4 = mold/protozoan mitochondrial. Carried on the sequence, not on the host, because a construct may target an organelle in a eukaryotic host.

cds.description: The editable coding region, starting exactly at the first base of the start codon.

protein.description: Derived from `cds`; stored so that invariant I3 can be checked in O(1) by digest comparison rather than by re-translating.

includes_stop.description: False for fusion partners and internal domains where the CDS continues past this record.

five_prime_flank.description: Immutable 5' context (UTR, RBS, upstream cistron tail). Participates in structure, k-mer and repeat objectives; never edited. Length 0 is legal.

locked_codons.description: Codon spans that no operator may alter. Populated by ingest from: the start codon, the stop codon, purification tags the user marked exact, overlapping-ORF regions, and any user-supplied lock.

source.description: Where this sequence came from. Required for auditability; a design job's output must be traceable to an input file.
